title: Dem Status Inject
source_docs: AUTOSAR Blockset/Classic Platform/Basic Software/Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem)/Dem_Status_Inject.md
text: 注入事件故障以测试恢复；按 {Trigger type} 指定注入条件；{EventID} 指定事件、{Fault type} 指定故障类型 Event、{Test Failed} 指示最近执行的测试的结果、{Test Failed this Operation Cycle} 指示诊断测试在当前操作周期内是否报告了失败、{Pending DTC} 指示诊断测试在当前或最近完成的操作周期内是否报告了失败、{Confirmed DTC} 指示是否已检测到足够多次故障，从而需要将 DTC 存储在长期内存中、{Test Not Complete Since Last Clear} 指示自上次调用 ClearDiagnosticInformation 以来测试是否已运行并完成、{Test Failed Since Last Clear} 指示自上次调用 ClearDiagnosticInformation 以来测试是否失败过、{Test Not Complete This Operation Cycle} 指定当前操作周期内未执行测试、{Warning Indicator Requested} 指示与特定 DTC 关联的任何警告指示器的状态，按实例取值。

params.name: Fault type
params.values: 指定故障类型 Event Fail (default) | Event Pass | Operation Cycle Start | Operation Cycle End | Fault Record Overwritten | Fault Maturation | Clear Diagnostic | Aging | Healing | Indicator Conditions Met

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: 指定注入条件 rising (default) | falling | either | function-call

params.name: Test Failed
params.values: 指示最近执行的测试的结果 Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Test Failed this Operation Cycle
params.values: 指示诊断测试在当前操作周期内是否报告了失败 Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Pending DTC
params.values: 指示诊断测试在当前或最近完成的操作周期内是否报告了失败 Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Confirmed DTC
params.values: 指示是否已检测到足够多次故障，从而需要将 DTC 存储在长期内存中 Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Test Not Complete Since Last Clear
params.values: 指示自上次调用 ClearDiagnosticInformation 以来测试是否已运行并完成 Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Test Failed Since Last Clear
params.values: 指示自上次调用 ClearDiagnosticInformation 以来测试是否失败过 Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Test Not Complete This Operation Cycle
params.values: 当前操作周期内未执行测试 Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Warning Indicator Requested
params.values: 指示与特定 DTC 关联的任何警告指示器的状态 Clear (default) | Set
